verdict.rationale: Fellow documents automatic 'suggested AI action items' for every meeting. Action items carry assignees and due dates, and they can be tracked through an action-item list with assigned_to_me/assigned_to_others scopes, complete/archive endpoints, completion webhooks, and MCP queries like 'What were my action items this week?'. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the AI automatically assigns owners from the conversation (items are only 'suggested'), detail on the in-app tracking view, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
